# A shift by a count that is the same every iteration maps to ShiftAllLeft and
# ShiftAllRight, which take the count as a uint64. The count is a constant or a
# variable of an unsigned type. Counts at and past the element width, and a signed
# right shift of negative numbers, behave as in Go.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ShlConst(dst, a []uint32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] << 3
	}
}

func ShlWide(dst, a []uint32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] << 40
	}
}

func ShrVar(dst, a []int32, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] >> n
	}
}

func ShlAssign(a []uint16) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] <<= 4
	}
}

func ShrUint64(dst, a []uint64, n uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] >> n
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func ShlConst(dst, a []uint32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] << 3
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2)
					_v1.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(3)).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(3)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(3)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(3)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(3)).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadUint32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(3)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func ShlWide(dst, a []uint32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] << 40
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2)
					_v1.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(40)).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(40)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(40)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(40)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(40)).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadUint32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(40)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func ShrVar(dst, a []int32, n uint) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] >> n
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v1.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func ShlAssign(a []uint16) {
	{
		_w1 := a[:len(a):len(a)]
		_count := len(_w1)
		_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint16s(0).Len()
		for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
			_c1 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes]
			_v1 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1)
			_v1.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(4)).Store(_c1)
			_v2 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1[_lanes:])
			_v2.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(4)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
			_v3 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_v3.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(4)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_v4 := simd.LoadUint16s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			_v4.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(4)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
		}
		for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
			_v5 := simd.LoadUint16s(_w1[_i:])
			_v5.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(4)).Store(_w1[_i:])
		}
		for _i < _count {
			_v6, _n := simd.LoadUint16sPart(_w1[_i:])
			_v6.ShiftAllLeft(uint64(4)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}

func ShrUint64(dst, a []uint64, n uint8) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] >> n
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastUint64s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2)
					_v1.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadUint64s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadUint64s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadUint64sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	u := []uint32{0, 1, 5, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678, 3, 255, 65536}
	dst := make([]uint32, len(u))
	test.ShlConst(dst, u)
	fmt.Printf("%#x\n", dst)
	test.ShlWide(dst, u)
	fmt.Printf("%#x\n", dst)

	s := []int32{0, 1, -1, -8, 100, -100, -2147483648, 2147483647, 5}
	out := make([]int32, len(s))
	for _, n := range []uint{0, 1, 2, 31, 32, 33, 40, 64, 1 << 40} {
		test.ShrVar(out, s, n)
		fmt.Println(n, out)
	}

	h := []uint16{1, 0xffff, 0x1234, 0x0fff, 0x8000}
	test.ShlAssign(h)
	fmt.Printf("%#x\n", h)

	q := []uint64{0, 1, 1 << 63, 1<<64 - 1, 12345678901234567}
	r := make([]uint64, len(q))
	for _, n := range []uint8{0, 1, 63, 64, 200} {
		test.ShrUint64(r, q, n)
		fmt.Printf("%d %#x\n", n, r)
	}
}

-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func ShlConst(dst, a []uint32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] << 3
	}
}

func ShlWide(dst, a []uint32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] << 40
	}
}

func ShrVar(dst, a []int32, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] >> n
	}
}

func ShlAssign(a []uint16) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] <<= 4
	}
}

func ShrUint64(dst, a []uint64, n uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] >> n
	}
}
